title: AWS Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

This role is responsible for establishing secure, scalable, highly available, and resilient AWS infrastructure across Development, Test, UAT, Parallel Run, and Production environments. The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands-on expertise in AWS cloud architecture, infrastructure automation, network design, security, disaster recovery, and environment provisioning. Experience supporting Micro Focus Enterprise Server or Rocket Enterprise Server workloads and large-scale application migration programs is highly desirable. This role will work closely with application modernization, database migration, DevOps, security, and platform engineering teams to ensure the cloud infrastructure is optimized to support mission-critical workloads throughout migration, testing, parallel validation, and production deployment phases. What you will do: Design and implement scalable AWS landing zones and cloud infrastructure architectures to support enterprise mainframe modernization programs. Architect and provision Development, Test, UAT, Parallel Run, Disaster Recovery, and Production environments. Define AWS infrastructure standards, security controls, governance policies, and operational best practices. Design secure networking architecture including: Amazon VPC Route 53 Security Groups Network ACLs NAT Gateways AWS Direct Connect VPN Connectivity Hybrid Cloud Networking Deploy and manage compute infrastructure using Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling Groups, Load Balancers, and Elastic Block Storage (EBS). Design storage and backup strategies utilizing Amazon S3, EBS snapshots, lifecycle management, and recovery solutions. Implement identity and access management controls using IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, and security best practices. Develop Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation. Establish monitoring, observability, logging, and alerting capabilities using CloudWatch and associated AWS services. Design and implement High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) architectures to meet business continuity objectives. Support infrastructure requirements for Micro Focus or Rocket Enterprise Server hosting environments. Enable secure integration with enterprise systems, databases, middleware, and external platforms. Collaborate with DevOps teams to integrate cloud infrastructure into CI/CD delivery pipelines. Conduct infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, performance tuning, and environment optimization activities. Drive AWS cost optimization initiatives through resource right-sizing, automation, and governance controls. Support migration planning, infrastructure cutovers, validation exercises, and production deployments. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Expertise Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline. 8-12+ years of infrastructure engineering and cloud platform experience. Minimum 5+ years of hands-on AWS architecture, engineering, and environment provisioning experience. Proven experience designing and deploying enterprise-scale AWS environments. Deep understanding of cloud networking, security, infrastructure automation, and operational excellence. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities. Experience working in complex enterprise transformation or migration programs. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Experience supporting mainframe modernization and replatforming programs. Experience with Micro Focus Enterprise Server or Rocket Enterprise Server infrastructure deployments. Exposure to enterprise database platforms and cloud-based database architectures. Experience supporting financial services, banking, insurance, or other highly regulated industries. Knowledge of DevSecOps and cloud security frameworks. Experience with infrastructure compliance and governance standards. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com. Job Description: About the Role As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be the finance-literate point of contact for customers' Controllers, FP&A teams, and CFO offices. You will resolve product issues that touch accounting logic, and you will help customers understand why their numbers look the way they do. This role combines technical troubleshooting with finance advisory, so both skill sets are essential. Key Responsibilities Case resolution Own and resolve support cases within SLAs across consolidation, budgeting, and reporting workloads. Diagnose issues in currency translation, intercompany processing, trial-balance mappings, data flows, and time-based aggregations (YTD, QTD, HTD) and summary methods. Reproduce issues in test environments, using event logs, error messages, and customer recordings to isolate root cause. Separate product defects from enhancement requests, set clear expectations with customers, and log well-documented tickets with reproduction steps. Coordinate with Engineering, Product, Cloud/DevOps, and Customer Success, providing escalations that state business impact clearly. Finance advisory Explain to finance users how the platform applies accounting logic, including consolidation methods, FX rates, eliminations, account roll-ups, and P&L versus balance-sheet aggregation. Advise on configuration choices for budget versions, scenarios, locking, and cycle opening. Write and maintain knowledge base articles for recurring finance questions. Continuous improvement Contribute to triage playbooks and AI-assisted support tools and help improve their training data. Mandatory Qualifications Education and certification Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or Economics, or an equivalent qualification. Professional qualification (CA, CMA, ACCA, or CFA) or an MBA in Finance is a strong plus. Finance experience Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in at least two of: financial consolidation, budgeting and planning, corporate accounting, or the financial close. Working knowledge of the consolidation process, including entity hierarchies and ownership, FX translation (average versus closing rates), intercompany matching and elimination, and chart-of-accounts mapping. Understanding of budget, actual, and forecast versioning, and of aggregation rules for P&L versus balance-sheet items. Hands-on experience with at least one corporate performance management (CPM) or enterprise performance management (EPM) platform. Experience supporting finance users in a customer-facing or ticket-based support role. Technical skills Advanced Excel: complex formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and Excel add-ins. Basic-to-intermediate SQL, and familiarity with data flows, ETL, or mapping concepts. Ability to read logs, error messages, and API responses (for example, OData responses or REST calls via Postman). Communication Clear written and spoken English for customer and engineering communication. Ability to explain accounting outcomes to finance users who are not technical. Preferred Qualifications Experience with multi-currency, multi-entity group reporting across EMEA or APAC. Experience with ERP-to-planning integrations and ERP finance modules. Familiarity with SaaS and private-cloud architectures, single sign-on, and network or allow-listing troubleshooting. Working knowledge of ticketing and CRM systems. Hands-on experience with AI-enabled support platforms. Core Competencies Finance-led troubleshooting: starting from the business outcome and working back to the cause. Clear communication with non-technical finance stakeholders. Prioritization under SLA pressure, across multiple customers and time zones. Judgment on when to escalate, and on distinguishing defects from enhancements. Openness to new tools and AI-assisted workflows. Additional Information All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Job Purpose The Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer – Full Stack builds and runs the Internal Hosting Portal that allows application teams across GSK to provision and manage Cloud resources in a self-service manner. The Hosting Portal is a custom-built web application using a modern TypeScript tech stack based on TypeScript. The full stack engineer sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through autoamted software deployment rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. Key Responsibilities Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. Strong experience with test automation (unit & integration) tools such as Jest and Cypress. Desirable: Familiar with building React web applications based on a Micro Frontend using Module Federation or Single SPA. undefined Developed REST APIs based on NodeJS (ExpressJS). undefined Experience of building and deploying web applications through CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps. undefined Knowledge of deploying, managing and monitoring web applications in a Cloud environment such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud. undefined Previously worked in a central IT team within a regulated environment such as the Pharmaceutical or Finance industry. Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. AWS - Cloud Engineer Tier – 8B 2-6 Years Customer Experience Platform Engineering Role Summary We are seeking an AWS Cloud Engineer to design, build, integrate, and support cloud-native customer experience capabilities within an Amazon Connect-powered contact center ecosystem. This role uses AWS services, APIs, serverless computing, event-driven architecture, and Infrastructure as Code to extend Amazon Connect and deliver seamless experiences across voice, chat, email, messaging, self-service, agent workflows, analytics, and enterprise systems. The ideal candidate combines hands-on AWS engineering expertise with experience in contact center technologies, customer journey design, and the operational needs of a large-scale customer experience platform. We operate with an AI-first engineering mindset and expect engineers to use AI-assisted practices responsibly to improve speed, quality, and innovation. Technical Skills Framework Primary skills are the tools and capabilities used by the team to perform the role. Each definition describes the core skill and its application within the Amazon Connect contact center ecosystem. Comparable skillsets represent adjacent experience that may transfer and accelerate onboarding, but are not technically aligned to the team’s current way of working. Primary Skills Skill Definition Comparable skillset Lambda Build scalable serverless applications, APIs, routing extensions, workflow services, and event-driven integrations that enhance Amazon Connect and support customer and agent experiences. Azure Functions; Google Cloud Functions TypeScript Develop maintainable, strongly typed services and integrations that support customer journeys, contact center workflows, and enterprise connectivity. Python; JavaScript AWS Services Engineer cloud-native capabilities using S3, DynamoDB, KMS, EventBridge, IAM, SQS, SNS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and related services to support interaction processing, notifications, orchestration, analytics, and secure integration with Amazon Connect. Comparable Azure or Google Cloud services CDK Implement Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK to automate consistent, secure deployment and management of Amazon Connect supporting services and customer experience capabilities. CloudFormation; Terraform API Gateway Design, secure, and manage REST and HTTP APIs that connect Amazon Connect, agent experiences, enterprise systems, and third-party contact center technologies. APIGEE; APIC Secondary Skills Skill Definition Comparable skillset Flows Understand Amazon Connect contact flow design, customer journeys, routing strategies, integration points, and troubleshooting so cloud services work effectively within end-to-end contact center experiences. Genesys Architect; NICE Studio; Five9 Studio; Cisco CVP Connect Desktop Understand Amazon Connect agent desktop configuration, routing profiles, agent workflows, and operational processes so cloud-native capabilities integrate seamlessly into the agent experience. Genesys Cloud administration; NICE CXone administration; Five9 administration Key Responsibilities Customer Experience Platform Engineering Design and develop cloud-native capabilities that extend Amazon Connect functionality and improve customer and agent experiences. Build services that enable customer self-service, routing enhancements, agent productivity, interaction processing, workflow orchestration, notifications, authentication, analytics, and experience optimization. Partner with Connect Engineers, Product Owners, architects, and business stakeholders to implement end-to-end customer journeys using Amazon Connect and supporting AWS services. Translate contact center and customer experience needs into scalable, reusable, and supportable technical capabilities. Contact Center Ecosystem Integration Develop APIs, event-driven services, and integration patterns that connect Amazon Connect with enterprise systems and third-party contact center technologies. Build integrations supporting voice, chat, email, messaging, customer authentication, outbound communications, workforce processes, analytics, and customer engagement capabilities. Integrate contact center workflows with customer, policy, claims, knowledge, workforce, communication, reporting, and other enterprise platforms. Contribute to migration and modernization initiatives that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and platform scalability. Cloud-Native Application Development Design, develop, test, and support serverless applications, APIs, microservices, and reusable platform services using Lambda, TypeScript, and related AWS technologies. Use event-driven and asynchronous patterns to process contact events, coordinate workflows, and decouple Amazon Connect from downstream systems. Design for resilience, scalability, performance, recoverability, security, and cost efficiency across the customer interaction lifecycle. Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps Implement Amazon Connect supporting infrastructure and AWS services using CDK and repeatable deployment patterns. Build and maintain CI/CD automation, testing, quality gates, security scanning, and environment promotion processes. Apply least-privilege access, encryption, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and enterprise cloud governance standards. API and Integration Engineering Design, secure, version, document, and operate APIs used by contact flows, agent applications, customer channels, and enterprise systems. Apply authentication, authorization, throttling, error handling, observability, and governance standards. Evaluate integration alternatives and document architectural decisions and tradeoffs based on customer experience, operational, and technical requirements. Platform Operations and Optimization Monitor production services and end-to-end contact center integrations, respond to incidents, and restore customer and agent capabilities. Use telemetry to identify customer journey failures, integration issues, performance constraints, and improvement opportunities. Perform root cause analysis and implement preventative improvements that increase reliability, recoverability, and operational supportability. Optimize cloud consumption while protecting customer experience, platform performance, and service resilience. AI-First Engineering Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, security, performance, maintainability, and compliance. Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to routing, self-service, agent support, analytics, and engineering productivity. Agile Delivery and Product Ownership Collaborate with Product Owners, Connect Engineers, architects, analysts, and Agile team members to refine requirements and user stories. Participate in planning, stand-ups, refinement, retrospectives, and demonstrations. Deliver working, production-ready customer experience capabilities aligned with sprint and program commitments. Use customer feedback, operational insights, and platform telemetry to continuously improve solutions. Quality, Security, and Operational Excellence Develop and maintain automated unit, integration, contract, and regression tests appropriate to contact center services and integrations. Participate in code and design reviews and follow established engineering standards. Apply secure coding, privacy, data protection, cloud security, and enterprise compliance requirements throughout the solution lifecycle. Demonstrate end-to-end ownership from design through production support and continuous improvement. Required Experience Hands-on experience building cloud-native applications, integrations, or platform services using AWS. Experience with contact center technologies or customer experience platforms such as Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, Five9, Cisco, or comparable platforms. Experience integrating contact center channels, routing, agent workflows, customer self-service, or interaction data with enterprise applications and services. Experience with Lambda, TypeScript or a comparable development language, API design, event-driven architecture, and Infrastructure as Code. Experience supporting production services through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, and root cause analysis. Professional Skills Strong analytical, systems-thinking, and problem-solving skills Ability to understand customer journeys and translate contact center needs into cloud-native solutions Clear communication and effective collaboration across product, operations, architecture, Connect engineering, and enterprise technology teams Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Agile environment End-to-end ownership from design through production support and continuous improvement Preferred Qualifications Direct experience integrating AWS services with Amazon Connect Experience building capabilities for voice, chat, email, messaging, self-service, agent desktop, workforce, or conversation analytics use cases Experience with contact center migration or large-scale customer experience platform transformation Experience with event-driven architectures and asynchronous integration patterns Experience with Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CloudWatch, Splunk, or comparable delivery and observability platforms AWS Developer, Solutions Architect, or relevant Amazon Connect certification Success Profile Delivers cloud-native capabilities that measurably improve customer and agent experiences. Builds scalable, secure, and resilient integrations that extend Amazon Connect. Demonstrates understanding of customer journeys, contact center operations, and the consequences of service failures. Creates reusable AWS services and patterns that accelerate delivery across the Customer Experience Platform. Balances customer experience, delivery speed, operational reliability, security, cost, and long-term architectural integrity. Uses AI-assisted engineering practices responsibly to improve productivity, quality, and innovation. Creates momentum by sharing knowledge, challenging assumptions, and partnering across Connect, cloud, product, and operations teams.

title: DevOps engineer (AWS Networking & Security) IRC307663
description: Description The Client is one of the majour insurance companies in the UK. This role supports a high-priority risk reduction programme for the MyCro Platform, a complex technology estate built on AWS. Platform SMEs have already designed remediation plans and started putting them into effect. The DevOps engineer we’re looking for will lock down subnet-level access to internal OpenSearch indexes and reconfigure the platform’s VPC and subnet design so egress from hosted Lambda functions and ECS clusters can be controlled. These are complex, platform-wide network changes that must be delivered with zero downtime. You will join a new squad led by a Platform SME. Requirements Essential experience Deep, hands-on AWS networking: VPC and subnet design, routing, security groups Delivering network re-architecture on live production platforms with zero downtime Controlling egress for serverless and container workloads Securing data stores at the network layer Technologies and tools Networking: Amazon VPC, subnets, route tables, NAT gateways, Internet gateways, Transit Gateway (if in use) Network security: Security groups, network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall, Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall Private connectivity: VPC endpoints (gateway and interface / PrivateLink) Data stores: Amazon OpenSearch Service (VPC domains, access policies) Workloads: AWS Lambda (VPC-attached), Amazon ECS (awsvpc networking) Observability: VPC Flow Logs, Reachability Analyzer, CloudWatch Infrastructure as code: AWS CloudFormation and/or AWS CDK, or Terraform Desirable Amazon OpenSearch Service security configuration AWS Network Firewall or equivalent egress filtering AWS certification (e.g. Advanced Networking – Specialty) Job responsibilities Restrict network access to internal Amazon OpenSearch domains using VPC placement, security groups and access policies Redesign VPC and subnet layout so Lambda and ECS workloads route through controlled egress points Implement egress controls such as NAT gateways, AWS Network Firewall, VPC endpoints (PrivateLink) and route table changes, per the agreed design Tighten security groups and network ACLs to least privilege Plan and execute zero-downtime migrations: staged cutovers, traffic validation, tested rollback Use VPC Flow Logs and Reachability Analyzer to baseline traffic before change and verify it after Deliver all network changes as infrastructure as code with peer review Produce network diagrams and runbooks for the platform team What we offer Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them. Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities! Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays. Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses. Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants! About GlobalLogic GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.
